assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-97.
CPT 93271 corresponds to cardiac event monitoring.
The payer that issued the denial is Cornerstone United.
The payer determined the service was bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, and R42.
The clinical findings are consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes.
Ordering documentation exists for the study.
The study was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation.
The service is a distinct, medically necessary service rather than a bundled component.
Reconsideration and payment are being requested via appeal.
